Remote Invigilation Solutions for Commonwealth Countries
Secure. Scalable. Candidate-Friendly.
Book a Demo
2500+ Global Recruiters in Amazing Companies Like These Use Talview
In the UK, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and other Commonwealth countries, remote invigilation is transforming how exams are delivered enabling candidates to take assessments anytime, anywhere, without compromising integrity. Talview’s patented Agentic AI platform, powered by
Alvy the world’s first AI proctoring agent
provides a secure, seamless, and scalable solution trusted by awarding bodies, universities, and professional certification providers across the Commonwealth.
Why Remote Invigilation Matters
Whether you’re delivering high-stakes university exams, professional certifications, or government assessments, credibility is everything. Remote invigilation ensures:
Exam Integrity
: Prevents cheating with advanced AI behaviour monitoring, secure browsers, and human oversight when needed.
Scalable Delivery
: Reach candidates across regions without the cost and logistics of test centres.
Accessibility
: Enable candidates in remote or rural areas to access exams on their own devices.
Regulatory Compliance
: Meets the standards required by Ofqual (UK), Australian Skills Quality Authority (ASQA), and other Commonwealth regulators.
Talview Remote Invigilation: How It Works
Candidate Authentication
AI-powered ID verification using facial recognition.
Ensures the right candidate is taking the exam.
Secure Testing Environment
Talview Secure Browser locks down the device.
Blocks switching tabs, screen sharing, or unauthorized applications.
AI + Human Monitoring
Alvy autonomously detects suspicious behaviour in real time.
Escalates to a trained human invigilator for review if needed.
Compliance & Reporting
Complete session recording for audit purposes.
Detailed reports for exam administrators.

Remote Invigilation vs Remote Proctoring: The Difference
In the U.S., the term
remote proctoring
is common.
In the UK, Australia, and other Commonwealth countries,
remote invigilation
is the preferred term.
While the terminology differs, Talview’s solution delivers the same world-class capabilities tailored to regional regulations and expectations.
